name: deploy
services:
  api:
    container_name: localqa-api
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
        required: true
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD-SHELL
        - wget -q --spider http://127.0.0.1:3000/readyz || exit 1
      timeout: 5s
      interval: 10s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 15s
    image: localqa-api:latest
    networks:
      backend: null
      frontend: null
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - type: volume
        source: localqa_data
        target: /var/localqa/data
        volume: {}
      - type: bind
        source: /Users/dcp/Documents/公司/momentic/deploy/secrets
        target: /run/secrets
        read_only: true
        bind: {}
  gateway:
    container_name: localqa-gateway
    depends_on:
      api:
        condition: service_healthy
        required: true
      web:
        condition: service_healthy
        required: true
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD-SHELL
        - wget -q --spider http://127.0.0.1:80/healthz || exit 1
      timeout: 5s
      interval: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 5s
    image: nginx:1.27-alpine
    networks:
      frontend: null
    ports:
      - mode: ingress
        target: 80
        published: "80"
        protocol: tcp
      - mode: ingress
        target: 443
        published: "443"
        protocol: tcp
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: /Users/dcp/Documents/公司/momentic/deploy/config/nginx.conf
        target: /etc/nginx/nginx.conf
        read_only: true
        bind: {}
      - type: bind
        source: /Users/dcp/Documents/公司/momentic/deploy/certs
        target: /etc/nginx/certs
        read_only: true
        bind: {}
  orchestrator:
    container_name: localqa-orchestrator
    depends_on:
      api:
        condition: service_healthy
        required: true
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
        required: true
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - node
        - /app/deploy/scripts/health-probe.mjs
        - --ready
      timeout: 5s
      interval: 15s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s
    image: localqa-orchestrator:latest
    networks:
      backend: null
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - type: volume
        source: localqa_data
        target: /var/localqa/data
        volume: {}
      - type: bind
        source: /Users/dcp/Documents/公司/momentic/deploy/secrets
        target: /run/secrets
        read_only: true
        bind: {}
  postgres:
    container_name: localqa-postgres
    environment:
      POSTGRES_DB: localqa
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD_FILE: /run/secrets/postgres_password
      POSTGRES_USER: localqa
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD-SHELL
        - pg_isready -U localqa -d localqa
      timeout: 3s
      interval: 5s
      retries: 10
      start_period: 5s
    image: postgres:18-alpine
    networks:
      backend: null
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - type: volume
        source: localqa_pgdata
        target: /var/lib/postgresql
        volume: {}
      - type: bind
        source: /Users/dcp/Documents/公司/momentic/deploy/secrets
        target: /run/secrets
        read_only: true
        bind: {}
  web:
    container_name: localqa-web
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD-SHELL
        - wget -q --spider http://127.0.0.1:80/ || exit 1
      timeout: 5s
      interval: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 5s
    image: localqa-web:latest
    networks:
      frontend: null
    restart: unless-stopped
  worker:
    cap_add:
      - SYS_ADMIN
    container_name: localqa-worker
    depends_on:
      api:
        condition: service_healthy
        required: true
    environment:
      HOME: /var/localqa/scratch
      PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH: /ms-playwright
      TMPDIR: /tmp
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - node
        - /app/deploy/scripts/health-probe.mjs
        - --ready
      timeout: 5s
      interval: 15s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 10s
    image: localqa-worker:unbuilt
    networks:
      backend: null
    restart: unless-stopped
    shm_size: "268435456"
    tmpfs:
      - /tmp:rw,noexec,nosuid,size=512m
      - /var/localqa/scratch:rw,nosuid,size=512m,mode=1777
    user: 1001:1001
    volumes:
      - type: volume
        source: localqa_data
        target: /var/localqa/data
        volume: {}
      - type: bind
        source: /Users/dcp/Documents/公司/momentic/deploy/secrets
        target: /run/secrets
        read_only: true
        bind: {}

    name: localqa-backend
    internal: true
  frontend:
    name: localqa-frontend
volumes:
  localqa_data:
    name: localqa-data
  localqa_pgdata:
    name: localqa-pgdata
